title: Uniformity of the Gaussian CDF transform
statement: Let $\Omega$ be a measurable space, let $\mu$ be a measure on $\Omega$, and let $X:\Omega\to\mathbb R$ be measure-preserving from $\mu$ to the standard Gaussian measure. For every $a\in[0,1]$, the real measure of $\{\omega\in\Omega:\Phi(X(\omega))\le a\}$ is $a$, where $\Phi$ is the standard Gaussian cumulative distribution function.
hypotheses_covered: $X:\Omega\to\mathbb R$ is measure-preserving to the standard Gaussian measure
